Both eventual -8 strong cores and all eventual P8+P8 existence already follow from the inspected classical Plaksin theorem via the Gaussian parity lift; exact all-target completion remains the candidate contribution.

Corrected HenriotNewTheorem5 plus fractional Holder: V(N)>>N/(logN)^(log4+epsilon); upper V(N)<<NJ12(N)/logN, uniformly all valuations.

Plaksin1984/1985 with Q8 and Gaussian forms, the integral parity map, prime-coordinate gcd deletion and doubling: ALL eventual strong-core and P8+P8 coverage, with coordinate counts >>N/log²N. No numerical onset here.
Fixed-content binary forms also covered after dividing bounded h|lcm(c1,c2).
